title: Ketamine infusion for symptomatological improvement of severe borderline personality disorder: a pilot study
official: Ketamine infusion for symptomatological improvement of severe borderline personality disorder: a pilot study
summary: Main objective: The main objective of this pilot study is to evaluate on day 9, in patients with severe borderline personality disorder (BPD), the evolution of the intensity of BPD symptoms (BSL) after the administration of two doses of Ketamine by IV infusion ( 0.5 mg/kg at 0 and 24 hours) in combination with the recommended first level care.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adult patient aged 18 to 65
2. Free, informed and written consent
3. Fluency in French
4. Diagnosis of borderline personality disorder according to DSM5 MINI criteria (5 out of 9 criteria)
5. Severe borderline personality disorder: BSL-23 score > or= 1.9 (“high” symptoms severity)
6. Patient having a background pharmacological treatment (antipsychotic, mood stabilizer, anti-depressant) and/or non-pharmacological (schema therapy, DBT) stable for four weeks
7. Person affiliated to or beneficiary of a social security system.
Exclusion criteria:
1. lifetime diagnosis or episode of psychotic disorder for the participant or for a first degree relative
2. specific absolute contraindication to ketamine: severe failure, stroke/TIA within the previous year, uncontrolled hypertension(BP>140/90), known hypersensitivity to ketamine, known Brugada syndrome or Major ECG abnormality (QTc>450ms)
3. Major ECG abnormality (corrected QT > 450 ms; ST segment abnormalities)
4. Cirrhosis or history of major disturbance in liver function tests (AST or ALT >2N or bilirubin >1,5 N)
5. hepatic or cutaneous porphyria
6. Participation in another interventional study involving humans or being in the exclusion period following previous research if applicable
7. Any reason clinically significant at inclusion baseline wich in the opinion of the investigator could compromise the safety of the participant
8. Protection measure for property and the person in progress (protection of justice, curatorship, guardianship)
9. Pregnant or breastfeeding woman
10. History of a manic or hypomanic episode
11. current severe depressive episode: MADRS > 35 before inclusion
12. ketamine abuse (ketamine taken several times a week)
13. Family history (first degree family) of psychotic disorder
14. long-term treatment (antidepressant, antipsychotic, thymoregulator) or specific intervention for BDP introduced in the previous four weeks
15. current prescription of MAOIs
